punchline: He tested the lemon juice with a photo, and the photo told him what he wanted to hear.
thirty_sec: McArthur Wheeler robbed banks in 1995 with lemon juice on his face, believing it made him invisible to cameras. Dunning and Kruger's 1999 studies asked whether weak performers can even see their own weakness.
question: Which belief of yours has only ever been checked by you?
key_contrast: Checking your own work with your own judgment, versus a test someone else designed to fail.
